identification: Two dormant bulbs in ~25 cm black plastic pots, consistent with Brunsvigia josephinae (Josephine's lily): large above-ground bulbs with long necks of dry papery tunics, roughly 10-12 cm across at the shoulder, so mid-size (several years old), probably not full flowering size (mature flowering bulbs usually 15-20 cm). Species not provable from a dormant bulb.
